title: Claude Fable 5.1 added
paragraphs: Claude Fable 5.1 was released on 2026-09-01 and joined the board the same day. Board row: {exactRate}% of answers within $1, #{rank} of {nModels}. {parsed} of {answers} answers parsed.

The model's API rejects forced tool calls, which is how the board collects most models' answers, so its row answers as a JSON object and reasons at the provider default. The serving-configuration table in the paper records the transport for every row.

Sensitivity: with the answer tool declared under tool_choice auto, Fable 5.1 scores {autoRate}% (would rank #{autoRank}). Under the same request Claude Fable 5 scores {fable5AutoRate}%. Fable 5's board row ({fable5BoardRate}%) ran chunked under a forced tool call, which switches off its thinking, so the {boardGap}-point gap between the two board rows is mostly request shape.
The next board version moves every model to tool_choice auto so each provider's default reasoning engages under the recorded request shape (policybench#139).
